title: Virtual wind tunnel (sphere, RANS k-omega SST)

warnings: The case uses the k-omega-sst RANS model with the logarithmic wall function (Re = 5.28e+5): keep the first node row at y+ 30–100, and expect a steady solution only where the flow is steady.

boundaryLayer.basis: turbulent flat plate, Cf = 0.026 Re^(-1/7), target y+ = 150

refinement: wake box, 0.5 body lengths, size 0.5 m

notes: An ideal-tetrahedron integral of the sizing law, scaled by the factor fitted on a sphere test; expect it within about a factor of two.

steps.label: Place the body in the tunnel frame
Carve the body out of the tunnel
Name the parts and drop the body interior
Snap the wall onto the surface
Write the mesh and the recipe

case: The body wall uses the RANS logarithmic wall function; its first node row is 5.11087 mm.
Force coefficients use the frontal area 0.502087 m², the body length 0.799805 m and the dynamic pressure 60.2 Pa.
The run is steady: up to 300 pseudo-time steps, stopping earlier when the solver converges. Raise the end time if it has not.
